acceptance: Each non-passed cell in a release UAT artifact names its failed queries and their errors.
context: Evidence: release-v2 run 40971306663 (tag v0.5.0rc2, commit b1459438d), for example artifact release-uat-v0.5.0rc2-stage1-sqlite, per-cell log sqlite_nyctaxi_0.01_*.log, whose failure tail holds only the result path.
description: For query_failure cells the shard artifact's failure tail is just the result JSON path on the runner; the result JSON is not uploaded. In run 40971306663 more than 100 failed cells cannot be diagnosed without a rerun. Upload result JSON, or at least the failed query IDs and error messages, for every non-passed cell.
